annotations.title: Connect a Baidu Webmaster site to a project

description: Set (or replace) a project's Baidu Webmaster site + push token. Baidu exposes no API to list or verify sites on an account, unlike Bing's GetUserSites — this stores the pair as given, with no live re-validation against Baidu. Requires the operator/user to have already verified the site on ziyuan.baidu.com and minted a push token there (Resource Submission -> Standard Inclusion -> API Submission).

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

siteUrl.description: Baidu's own `site` value, taken verbatim from ziyuan.baidu.com.

token.description: The site-specific push token minted on ziyuan.baidu.com AFTER completing Baidu's own site-ownership verification there — a real, external, one-time setup step this tool cannot automate.

name: set_baidu_connection
